execution_policy: Run only after all six timed panels have finished and the timing slot is released. Run the independent verifier first; the reporting driver consumes its output. These commands read evidence and write new derived artifacts, without launching estimators. Do not overwrite existing audit/report artifacts.
acceptance_interpretation: Numerical/integrity acceptance is separate from speed acceptance. The reporting driver assesses every one of the 432 declared Digits GPU comparisons and all 48 distance-weighted regression margin comparisons. Every below-1 result against the immediate prior automatic implementation remains visible; it is not hidden by wins against GPU or sklearn. The two order/warmup protocols are retained separately and absolute timings are not compared across them.
